svg.aria-label: Instruction buffer and FTQ occupancy against cycle for fd20_backpressure
svg.text: The stall reaches the instruction buffer first and the FTQ later. The redirect at cyc 526 empties both.
Read from out/fd20_backpressure/fd20_backpressure.fst. Both drop at cyc 34 and 58, the redirects of the first passes.
